notes.it: Server MCP ufficiale Cloudflare (API completa, docs, containers, browser). OAuth 2.1 con Dynamic Client Registration. Fonti: https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare e https://blog.cloudflare.com/remote-model-context-protocol-servers-mcp
notes.en: Cloudflare's official MCP server (full API, docs, containers, browser). OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare and https://blog.cloudflare.com/remote-model-context-protocol-servers-mcp

notes.it: Server MCP ospitato da Sentry (repo ufficiale getsentry/toolkit): OAuth dal browser, nessuna chiave da creare. Fonti: https://mcp.sentry.dev e https://github.com/getsentry/toolkit
notes.en: MCP server hosted by Sentry (official getsentry/toolkit repo): OAuth from the browser, no key to create. Sources: https://mcp.sentry.dev and https://github.com/getsentry/toolkit

notes.it: Server MCP ufficiale Stripe (pagamenti, fatture, abbonamenti); OAuth con consenso sulla pagina Stripe (modalità test disponibile). Fonte: https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
notes.en: Stripe's official MCP server (payments, invoices, subscriptions); OAuth with consent on the Stripe page (test mode available). Source: https://docs.stripe.com/mcp

notes.it: Server MCP remoto ufficiale Notion: lettura e aggiornamento del workspace via OAuth. Fonte: https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/overview
notes.en: Notion's official remote MCP server: read and update the workspace via OAuth. Source: https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/overview

notes.it: Server MCP remoto ufficiale Linear (issue, progetti, commenti): autenticazione con login Linear. Fonti: https://linear.app/integrations/claude e https://linear.app/integrations/codex-mcp
notes.en: Linear's official remote MCP server (issues, projects, comments): authentication with Linear login. Sources: https://linear.app/integrations/claude and https://linear.app/integrations/codex-mcp

notes.it: Server MCP ufficiale Google per Gmail (Developer Preview). Registrazione statica: serve un client OAuth proprio, vedi docs/google-oauth.md. Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products
notes.en: Google's official MCP server for Gmail (Developer Preview). Static registration: you need your own OAuth client, see docs/google-oauth.md. Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products

notes.it: Server MCP ufficiale Google per Calendar (Developer Preview). Registrazione statica: client OAuth proprio come per Gmail (docs/google-oauth.md). Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products
notes.en: Google's official MCP server for Calendar (Developer Preview). Static registration: your own OAuth client as for Gmail (docs/google-oauth.md). Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products

notes.it: Server MCP ufficiale Google per Drive (Developer Preview). Registrazione statica: client OAuth proprio come per Gmail (docs/google-oauth.md). Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products
notes.en: Google's official MCP server for Drive (Developer Preview). Static registration: your own OAuth client as for Gmail (docs/google-oauth.md). Endpoint: https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products
